articles.title: Ancient Footprints Reveal a Vanishing Lake at White Sands
articles.summary: Scientists studying ancient footprints at White Sands found people repeatedly visited a lake that shrank and dried as the climate warmed and swung sharply.

articles.title: Why Bogs Preserve Bodies for Thousands of Years
articles.summary: Acidic, oxygen-poor peat bogs pickle soft tissue and protect skin and hair, while their acid weakens bones.

articles.title: Teaching Machines to Listen Like People, Only Better
articles.summary: MIT researcher Paris Smaragdis is teaching computers to understand sound, from traffic accidents to breaking drills, after a musical path that led him to machine learning.
